d:
India’s incredible journey to the Moon started with Chandrayaan-1, the country’s first lunar mission developed by ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation).
Launched on October 22, 2008, Chandrayaan-1 travelled from Earth to the Moon and became one of India’s most important space achievements. This mission helped scientists study the lunar surface and made a groundbreaking discovery — the presence of water molecules on the Moon.
In this educational space video, kids will learn:
How Chandrayaan-1 was launched
The amazing journey from Earth to the Moon
How the spacecraft travelled through space
